definitions.explanation: Clothes and clothing products, especially as commercial goods or merchandise.

examples.japanese: {衣料品|いりょうひん}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{衣料品|いりょうひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子供|こども}{向|む}け→子供向け：17933_kodomomuke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{衣料品|いりょうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{扱|あつか}っている→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧。
examples.english: This store mainly carries children's clothing.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{衣料|いりょう}→衣料：02612_iryou⟧ (clothing material) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (goods). A commercial and business term for clothing products. More commonly seen in department stores, retail, and industry contexts than in everyday speech, where ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ or ⟦{洋服|ようふく}→洋服：05014_youfuku⟧ are preferred.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {衣料品|いりょうひん}{店|てん}: clothing store
- {衣料品|いりょうひん}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: clothing department; clothing section
- {衣料品|いりょうひん}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧: clothing manufacturer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: clothes — everyday term
- ⟦{洋服|ようふく}→洋服：05014_youfuku⟧: Western-style clothing — common everyday word
- {被服|ひふく}: clothing; garments — formal/technical, used in industry and military contexts
- アパレル: apparel — industry term borrowed from English
